title: CLUMAP: Clustered Mapper for CGRAs with Predication
problem: Mapping applications onto complex CGRA architectures with multi-context and predication support is challenging. Current approaches struggle with placement and routing complexity in these advanced reconfigurable architectures.
motivation: CGRAs have become popular accelerators for compute-intensive kernels, and better mapping techniques enable broader kernel support and improved hardware utilization.
method: CLUMAP proposes an architecture-agnostic clustered mapping approach that groups operations to simplify the placement problem. It introduces a novel cost function optimized for simulated-annealing based placement. The technique separates and streamlines placement and routing phases to reduce overall mapping complexity.
key_novelty: Architecture-agnostic clustered mapping with a specialized simulated-annealing cost function that generalizes across different CGRA designs without architecture-specific modifications.
contributions: An architecture-agnostic clustered mapping technique for CGRAs with predication
A novel cost function tailored for simulated-annealing based placement optimization
Simplified placement and routing methodology reducing mapping complexity
Demonstrated mapping speedup on HyCUBE and ADRES with increased mapping success for ADRES

metrics.speedup: Significant speedup demonstrated for HyCUBE and ADRES architectures
metrics.other: Increased mapping success rate for ADRES architecture
